item.question: A short stay or 23-hour ward in a general and academic children's hospital: are they effective?
item.answer: This data demonstrates the robust nature of the short stay ward. At these two very different institutions we have shown improved bed efficient and patient care in a cost-effective way. We have also reported on greater parental satisfaction and early return of the child with their family to the community.
